# 1. Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(future)
library(Matrix)
library(HDF5Array)
library(data.table)
library(GenomeInfoDb)})

plan("multicore", workers = 4)

SCRIPT_DIR <- getwd()   
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")                     
DATA_DIR      <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data")
EQTL_DIR  <- file.path(DATA_DIR, "eqtl_files")
dir.create(EQTL_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
```


# 3. eQTL
## Download eQTL's
```{r}
cell_types_eqtl <- c("Ast", "End", "Ext", "IN", "MG", "OD", "OPC")  
base_url <- "https://zenodo.org/records/14908182/files"
files <- paste0(cell_types_eqtl, "_eqtl_full_assoc.tsv.gz")

options(timeout = max(300, getOption("timeout")))
for (f in files) {
  dest <- file.path(EQTL_DIR, f)
  if (!file.exists(dest)) {
    url <- paste0(base_url, "/", f, "?download=1")
    message("Downloading ", f, " ...")
    try(download.file(url, destfile = dest, mode = "wb"))
  }
}
```

# 2. Load Existing Seurat
```{r}
# 2. Load Existing Seurat
seo <- readRDS(file.path(DATA_DIR, "seo_RNA_ATAC_chr123.rds"))
barcodes <- colnames(seo)

DefaultAssay(seo) <- "ATAC"
atac <- GetAssayData(seo, slot = "counts")

# Build GRanges and table
peak_tbl <- tstrsplit(rownames(atac), "-", keep = 1:3)
peak_tbl <- data.table(
  peak  = rownames(atac),
  chr   = peak_tbl[[1]],
  start = as.integer(peak_tbl[[2]]),
  end   = as.integer(peak_tbl[[3]])
)[, mid := (start + end) %/% 2L]

peaks <- GRanges(seqnames = peak_tbl$chr,
                 ranges   = IRanges(peak_tbl$start, peak_tbl$end))
mcols(peaks)$peak <- peak_tbl$peak
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "UCSC"
peaks <- peaks[as.character(seqnames(peaks)) %in% c("chr1","chr2","chr3")]
```

## Candidate Links
```{r}
labels <- c("astrocytes","endothelial","Neurons","Microglia","Oligodendrocytes","OPC")

ensdb    <- EnsDb.Hsapiens.v86
genes_db <- genes(ensdb, filter = ~ gene_biotype == "protein_coding")
tss_pos  <- ifelse(strand(genes_db)=="+", start(genes_db), end(genes_db))
gr_tss   <- GRanges(seqnames=seqnames(genes_db), ranges=IRanges(tss_pos, width=1),
                    strand=strand(genes_db), gene_id=genes_db$gene_id)
GenomeInfoDb::seqlevelsStyle(gr_tss) <- "UCSC"
gr_tss <- keepStandardChromosomes(gr_tss, pruning.mode="coarse")

link_kb <- 500; prom_kb <- 1
gr_link <- promoters(gr_tss, upstream=link_kb*1000, downstream=link_kb*1000)
mcols(gr_link)$gene_id <- mcols(gr_tss)$gene_id
gr_prom <- promoters(gr_tss, upstream=prom_kb*1000, downstream=prom_kb*1000)

# promoter-overlapping peaks 
ov_prom     <- findOverlaps(peaks, gr_prom, ignore.strand=TRUE)
prom_peaks  <- unique(mcols(peaks)$peak[queryHits(ov_prom)])

# Seurat object to define presence per CT
stopifnot("cell_type_manual" %in% colnames(seo@meta.data))
seo <- subset(seo, cells = rownames(seo@meta.data)[seo@meta.data$cell_type_manual %in% labels])
seo@meta.data$cell_type_manual <- factor(seo@meta.data$cell_type_manual, levels=labels)

DefaultAssay(seo) <- "ATAC"
atac <- GetAssayData(seo, "ATAC", "counts")

DefaultAssay(seo) <- "RNA"
rna <- GetAssayData(seo, "RNA", "counts")

min_peak_frac <- 0.0 
min_gene_frac <- 0.0  


make_ct_labels <- function(ct_code, ct_file_codes) {
  message("CT: ", ct_code)
  cells <- rownames(seo@meta.data)[seo@meta.data$cell_type_manual == ct_code]
  if (!length(cells)) { message("  No cells for ", ct_code); return(NULL) }

  ## peaks present in this CT
  atac_ct    <- atac[, cells, drop=FALSE]
  keep_peaks <- rownames(atac_ct)[ Matrix::rowMeans(atac_ct > 0) >= min_peak_frac ]
  keep_peaks <- intersect(keep_peaks, peak_tbl$peak)
  peaks_ct   <- peaks[mcols(peaks)$peak %in% keep_peaks]

  ## genes present in this CT
  rna_ct        <- rna[, cells, drop=FALSE]
  gene_present  <- rownames(rna_ct)[ Matrix::rowMeans(rna_ct > 0) >= min_gene_frac ]
  if (!all(grepl("^ENSG", gene_present))) {
    map <- AnnotationDbi::select(ensdb, keys=unique(gene_present),
                                 keytype="SYMBOL", columns="GENEID")
    map <- unique(map[!is.na(map$GENEID), ])
    gene_present_ensg <- unique(map$GENEID)
  } else gene_present_ensg <- unique(gene_present)
  gr_tss_ct <- gr_tss[mcols(gr_tss)$gene_id %in% gene_present_ensg]
  if (length(peaks_ct) == 0L || length(gr_tss_ct) == 0L) { message("  No peaks/genes for ", ct_code); return(NULL) }

  ## TSS-centered candidates minus promoter peaks
  gr_link_ct <- promoters(gr_tss_ct, upstream=link_kb*1000, downstream=link_kb*1000)
  mcols(gr_link_ct)$gene_id <- mcols(gr_tss_ct)$gene_id
  ov_ct <- findOverlaps(peaks_ct, gr_link_ct, ignore.strand=TRUE)
  cand <- unique(data.table(
    peak    = mcols(peaks_ct)$peak[queryHits(ov_ct)],
    gene_id = mcols(gr_link_ct)$gene_id[subjectHits(ov_ct)]
  ))
  cand <- cand[ !peak %in% prom_peaks ]
  # add chr/tss/mid + distance filter
  cand <- merge(cand, peak_tbl[, .(peak, chr, mid)], by="peak", all.x=TRUE)
  tss_dt <- as.data.table(gr_tss_ct)[, .(gene_id, chr_tss=as.character(seqnames), tss=start)]
  cand   <- merge(cand, tss_dt, by="gene_id", all.x=TRUE)
  cand[, peak_gene_distance := abs(mid - tss)]
  cand <- cand[ peak_gene_distance < link_kb*1000 ][, c("mid","tss") := NULL ]
  if (!nrow(cand)) { message("  No (peak,gene) candidates for ", ct_code); return(NULL) }

  ## read eQTL for this CT (possibly multiple sources, e.g. Ext+IN)
  read_one <- function(code) {
    p <- file.path(EQTL_DIR, paste0(code, "_eqtl_full_assoc.tsv.gz"))
    if (!file.exists(p)) { message("  Missing eQTL file: ", basename(p)); return(NULL) }
    fread(p, select=c("feature","variant_id","Fixed_P","chr","pos"))
  }
  eqtl_list <- lapply(ct_file_codes, read_one)
  eqtl_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), eqtl_list)
  if (!length(eqtl_list)) return(NULL)

  eqtl <- rbindlist(eqtl_list, use.names=TRUE, fill=TRUE)
  eqtl[, gene_id := sub("\\..*", "", feature)]
  if (!all(grepl("^chr", eqtl$chr))) eqtl[, chr := paste0("chr", chr)]

  ## If same (variant,gene) appears multiple times (Ext vs IN), keep min p
  setorder(eqtl, variant_id, gene_id, Fixed_P)
  eqtl <- eqtl[, .SD[1L], by = .(variant_id, gene_id)]

  ## label rule on collapsed eQTLs
  pos_cutoff <- 1e-6; strong_cut <- 1e-2; neg_cutoff <- 0.4
  strong <- eqtl[Fixed_P < strong_cut]
  eqtl[, label := fifelse(Fixed_P < pos_cutoff, 1L,
                   fifelse(Fixed_P > neg_cutoff &
                           variant_id %in% strong$variant_id &
                           gene_id   %in% strong$gene_id, 2L, 3L))]

  ## SNP ↔ peaks of this CT
  snp_gr  <- GRanges(seqnames=eqtl$chr, ranges=IRanges(eqtl$pos, width=1))
  hits_ct <- findOverlaps(snp_gr, peaks_ct, ignore.strand=TRUE)
  if (!length(hits_ct)) { message("  No SNP↔peak overlaps for ", ct_code); return(NULL) }

  peak_str_ct <- sprintf("%s-%d-%d",
                         as.character(seqnames(peaks_ct))[subjectHits(hits_ct)],
                         start(peaks_ct)[subjectHits(hits_ct)],
                         end(peaks_ct)[subjectHits(hits_ct)])

  snppg <- data.table(
    variant_id = eqtl$variant_id[queryHits(hits_ct)],
    chr        = eqtl$chr       [queryHits(hits_ct)],
    pos        = eqtl$pos       [queryHits(hits_ct)],
    gene_id    = eqtl$gene_id   [queryHits(hits_ct)],
    Fixed_P    = eqtl$Fixed_P   [queryHits(hits_ct)],
    label      = eqtl$label     [queryHits(hits_ct)],
    peak       = peak_str_ct
  )

  ## keep only CT (peak,gene) candidates (chr join is redundant but ok)
  setkey(snppg, peak, gene_id, chr)
  setkey(cand,  peak, gene_id, chr)
  snppg <- snppg[cand, nomatch=0]
  if (!nrow(snppg)) { message("  No SNP–peak–gene after CT filtering for ", ct_code); return(NULL) }

  snppg[, snp := sprintf("%s-%d-%d", chr, as.integer(pos)-1L, as.integer(pos))]
  snppg[, celltype := ct_code]

  ## aggregate: one SNP with lowest p per (peak,gene_id,celltype)
  setorder(snppg, Fixed_P)
  snppg_agg <- snppg[, .SD[1L], by = .(peak, gene_id, celltype)]

  ## map SYMBOL **after** aggregation
  sym <- AnnotationDbi::select(ensdb, keys=unique(snppg_agg$gene_id),
                               keytype="GENEID", columns="SYMBOL")
  sym <- unique(data.table(gene_id=sym$GENEID, gene=sym$SYMBOL))
  setkey(sym, gene_id); setkey(snppg_agg, gene_id)
  snppg_agg <- sym[snppg_agg]
  snppg_agg[is.na(gene) | gene=="", gene := gene_id]

  ## final return
  snppg_agg[, .(peak, gene_id, gene, celltype, label, Fixed_P)]
}


ct_map <- data.table(
  ct_code   = c("Neurons","astrocytes","endothelial","Microglia","Oligodendrocytes","OPC"),
  eqtl_name = I(list(c("Ext","IN"), "Ast","End","MG","OD","OPC"))
)

all_lab <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(ct_map)), function(i)
  make_ct_labels(ct_map$ct_code[i], ct_map$eqtl_name[[i]])),
  use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)

# Sanity checks
dup_summary <- all_lab[, .N, by=.(peak, gene_id, celltype)][N > 1]
cat("Remaining duplicated (peak,gene_id,celltype): ", nrow(dup_summary), "\n")

# Save
out_path <- file.path(EQTL_DIR, "training_data_snppg_aggregated_new.tsv.gz")
fwrite(all_lab[, .(peak, gene_id, gene, celltype, label, Fixed_P)], out_path, sep="\t")
cat("Wrote: ", out_path, " (", nrow(all_lab), " rows)\n", sep="")

# Optional: assert file exists
stopifnot(file.exists(out_path))
```
